newsitem.title: HUNGARY: FERENCVAROS BEATS NEWCASTLE 3-2 IN UEFA CUP TIE.
newsitem.headline: FERENCVAROS BEATS NEWCASTLE 3-2 IN UEFA CUP TIE.

text.p: Newcastle United were made to pay for two defensive errors as they lost 3-2 to Hungarians Ferencvaros in their UEFA Cup first leg tie in Budapest.
A weak back pass by Belgian defender Phillipe Albert let in Ferenc Horvath for the opening goal on 5 minutes.
Just ten minutes later Horvath headed against the post and Krisztian Lisztes drew home to give the Hungarians a surprise 2-0 lead.
Newcastle clawed their way back into the game when Les Ferdinand headed in from close range on 23 minutes after fine work from Shearer.
Shearer brought the game level with a powerful volley on 34 minutes.
But Ferencvaros got their reward for a battling performance when Lisztes pounced on a misdirected clearance by Beardsley and fired in the winner on 55 minutes.

FERENCVAROS: Jozsef Szeiler 20, Andras Telek 3, Janos Hrutka 12, Sergei Kuzniecov 20, Mihaly Szucs 13, Elek Nyilas 9, Krisztian Lisztes 10 (Richard Hollo 23 - 78th), Vasile Miriuta 8, Norbert Nagy 4, Ferenc Horvath 5, Norbert Nagy 4, Ferenc Horvath 5 (Gabor Zavadszky 19 - 58th), Igor Nyichenko 11.

NEWCASTLE: Pavel Srnicek 1, Steven Watson 19, Darren Peacock 5, Phillipe Apbert 12, John Beresford 3, Keith Gillespie 18 (David Ginola 14 - 64th), David Batty 4, Peter Beardsley 8, Robert Lee 7, Les Ferdinand 10, Alan Shearer 9.
